tolerances.rcond_normalisation: LAPACK dgecon 1-norm estimate of H/(s s'), s_k = sqrt(max(rowmax_k, colmax_k))
tolerances.tol_metric_residual_normalisation: sqrt((S/n)' A^{-1} (S/n)); S raw estimating-equation sum, n fitted observations; A = H_Gamma/n for the raw-sum Gamma-pilot curvature or A = B'B/n for the already-averaged design-Gram fallback; lower Cholesky factor of A only
tolerances.tol_metric_step_normalisation: sqrt(p' A p), p = H^{-1} S exact Newton correction of the original equation, same fixed A as the residual
tolerances.tol_root_normalisation: absolute beta difference between accepted roots from different starts
